messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — spotted a token/invoice mismatch after last night's partial ingest outage. Dashboard shows ~12.0M tokens for acct-42 but invoice says 9.8M. Starting thread to coordinate a backfill + reconciliation.
Kevin Patel: ack. Can you paste the query you used for dashboard metric and the invoice run id?
Maya Chen: dashboard query is the usual `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM token_events WHERE account_id = 'acct-42' AND ts >= '2026-11-02' AND ts < '2026-11-03'`. Invoice id `inv_20261103_acct42`.
Julian Ortiz: tagging the replay infra folks @Samira — we saw a producer retry storm during the outage window, might have duplicated events that the stream dedupe missed.
Samira Khan: looking now. Initial check: the eventstore has ~1.25M duplicate event_ids for that window, likely from the retry loop with no ack. I'm going to run a dry-run of the replay tool to see what would be applied.
Samira Khan: dry-run command: ```
./event-replay --mode=dry-run --from=2026-11-02T02:00:00Z --to=2026-11-02T06:00:00Z --account=acct-42 --dedupe=event_id
```
Kevin Patel: good. Billing wants a conservative plan — we can't change invoices retroactively without a clear, auditable backfill and checksum compare. Please snapshot ledger before any writes.
Maya Chen: agreed. Proposed plan: 1) snapshot `billing_ledger` table (read-only copy) 2) run replay dry-run with `--dedupe` and capture predicted delta 3) run replay in `apply` mode to a staging ledger table 4) compute checksums + itemized token deltas 5) present to billing for adjustment clause.
Julian Ortiz: I'll take step 1 and 3 (snapshot + apply to staging). Samira will run the dry-run and produce the patch file.
Samira Khan: dry-run output shows predicted +2,160,432 tokens compared to current ingestion totals for that window. Most duplicates are exact event_id repeats. I'll produce a `replay.patch.jsonl` with idempotent ops.
Maya Chen: can you include the checksum command you used? we need reproducible steps in the ticket.
Samira Khan: checksum snippet: ```
-- ledger snapshot checksum
SELECT md5(array_agg(id || ':' || tokens ORDER BY id)::text) FROM billing_ledger_snapshot WHERE account_id='acct-42' AND ts >= '2026-11-02' AND ts < '2026-11-03';
```
Kevin Patel: once staging apply is done, run the compare: ```
SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM billing_ledger_staging WHERE account_id='acct-42' AND ts >= '2026-11-02' AND ts < '2026-11-03';
SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM billing_ledger_snapshot WHERE account_id='acct-42' AND ts >= '2026-11-02' AND ts < '2026-11-03';
```
Maya Chen: OpsBot, please lock live invoice adjustments for this account until reconciliation complete.
OpsBot: @Maya Chen — locking invoice adjustments for acct-42. Lock id: lock-20261103-7f3. :lock:
Julian Ortiz: staging apply finished — `billing_ledger_staging` created. Produced staging checksum `3a7f9b2d`.
Samira Khan: applied replay in staging, staging tokens = original +2,160,432, matches dry-run. Generated `replay.patch.jsonl` and upload to S3 at s3://redwood-replays/acct-42/20261103/replay.patch.jsonl.gz
Maya Chen: great. Kevin — can you validate the predicted delta against `inv_20261103_acct42` policy for adjustments? We need approval to emit a credit or reissue invoice.
Kevin Patel: quick check — policy allows crediting up to 5% for system-initiated duplicates with audit trail. This delta is ~21% for that window, needs finance + legal signoff. I'll open a billing escalation ticket with attachments (snapshot checksums, replay.patch, staging compare SQL).
Maya Chen: action items summary: - Samira: upload patch + dry-run logs (done) - Julian: keep staging snapshot + export checksums (done) - Kevin: open billing escalation and route to finance/legal - OpsBot: keep lock until release by billing.
Samira Khan: note: we also found 14k events with corrupted token counts (token field null). I'm attaching a script to sanitize them during replay. ```
# simple sanitizer applied in replay pipeline
if event.tokens is None:
  event.tokens = estimate_tokens(event.payload)
  event.tags.append('sanitized_missing_tokens')
```
Maya Chen: thanks. We'll include sanitized flag in the audit so customers can see what was corrected. Anything else?
Billing Team: please include customer-facing note template. Draft: "We detected duplicated usage during a partial ingest outage on Nov 2. We're reconciling and will issue any necessary credits; details follow."
Maya Chen: thanks everyone — I'll compile this into incident ticket INC-20261103-metering-gap and attach all artifacts. Leaving thread open for post-adjustment confirmation. :white_check_mark:
